question: Which of the following events are correct? 1. The Magic Treasure (法宝) used by the player when fighting the Sui Commander is the Fire Shield (避火罩) 2. The Magic Treasure (法宝) used by the player when fighting the Gray Bronze War Chariot is the Embroidered Needle (绣花针) 3. The Magic Treasure (法宝) used by the player when fighting the Sui Vanguard is the Fire Shield (避火罩) 4. The Magic Treasure (法宝) used by the player when fighting Wang Lingguan at Mount Huaguo (花果山) is the Embroidered Needle (绣花针) 5. The Magic Treasure (法宝) used by the player when fighting Great Shigandang (大石敢当) is the Banana Leaf Fan (芭蕉扇)

rollouts.answer: Only event 1 correct (based on item acquired at ~6150s). 2,3,4,5 marked false.

decisive_steps.what_happened: semantic_search on topic_facts for '避火罩' returns the item-ACQUISITION popup at 6150s as top hit; agent treats this as the 'used' event for Sui Commander instead of searching for a later USE near the clue window (67480-67516).
semantic_search for chariot/绣花针 returns event_steps at 71970s (a different, wrong chariot fight, 赤金战车) rather than the correct chariot fight near 65229-65270.
submit_answer issued from text-only reasoning; no visual/clip_qa verification was ever performed for any of the 5 claims.

rollouts.failure_point: Never called clip_qa; anchored on the item-acquisition scene (6150s) and on textually-similar but temporally wrong boss encounters (14k/17k/71k s) instead of the true clue windows (65k-81k s), where no literal boss-name text exists in the DB.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Confirmed via sql that 避火罩/辟火罩 text only appears once in episodes/topic_facts, at the 6150s acquisition scene, not again near any of the 5 clue windows -- so this rollout's anchor point was real but not the 'used' event the question asks about.

db_evidence.notes: Boss identities near the true clue windows are confirmed in the DB: 赤焰麒麟 boss fight at 67470-67530 (event 1, Sui Commander), an unnamed 'horned demon' fight ending 65370 (event 2, chariot -- though the earlier 63930-65270 stretch is where 绣花针 use was actually visually confirmed by rollout 3), a molten-golem boss fight at 74760-75150 (event 3, Sui Vanguard), 王灵官 explicitly named and defeated at 77250-77460 (event 4, Wang Lingguan -- literal text match, easy to find, and correctly judged false by every rollout that checked it), and a 'blue-nodule boss (慈悲)' defeated at 80846-80885 (event 5, Great Shigandang). Only event 4's boss name is literally present as text near its clue window; events 1, 2, 3 and 5 have no literal boss-name or magic-treasure-name text near their clue intervals -- the treasure names (避火罩, 绣花针, 芭蕉扇) only appear as literal text at earlier, unrelated acquisition/equip scenes (e.g. 避火罩 acquired at 6150s, 芭蕉扇 shown in inventory at 76650-78540s), which repeatedly lured every rollout's text-based search away from the correct usage windows. Confirming the treasure actually used in each of the 5 target fights requires clip_qa frame inspection of the HUD/skill-slot icon precisely inside each clue interval; no rollout did this for all 5 claims, and most did it for none of the correct windows.

root_causes: Semantic_search and run_sql text queries built from the question's English boss names (Sui Commander, gray bronze war chariot, Sui Vanguard, Great Shigandang) matched earlier, differently-identified but visually/thematically similar encounters (e.g. Tiger Vanguard vs Sui Vanguard, 赤金战车 vs the true chariot fight, an early stone-golem boss vs the true Great Shigandang) because the DB captions never use the question's exact English/Chinese names for the true late-game instances.

The three positive-label magic-treasure names (避火罩, 绣花针, 芭蕉扇) appear as literal text in the DB only at item-acquisition/inventory scenes far from the clue windows (e.g. 6150s, 76650-78540s), so lexical search repeatedly anchored rollouts on acquisition rather than in-combat usage.

Two of five rollouts (0 and 4, the highest-scoring pair by coincidence) never invoked clip_qa at all, despite the question requiring visual HUD confirmation of which treasure icon is active during each specific fight -- an inherently non-textual fact.

Even the three rollouts that did use clip_qa (1, 2, 3) mostly pointed the visual sub-agent at the wrong, textually-derived time windows, so the visual answers were accurate about the wrong scene rather than wrong about the right scene.

No rollout cross-checked its chosen time window against the boss defeat/HUD banner text (e.g. '王灵官 已击败' at 77430-77460, 'blue-nodule boss (慈悲)' defeated at 80880) for all five sub-claims before committing to a window, which would have caught most of the misidentifications.
what_worked: Event 4 (Wang Lingguan) was almost universally handled correctly because 王灵官 is explicit literal text in the DB right at the clue window (77250-77460), letting every rollout that checked it correctly conclude no clear needle evidence and mark it false, matching the reference.
Rollout 3's clip_qa at 63930-64080 landed close enough to the true chariot clue window (65229-65270) to visually confirm 绣花针 use and score that one sub-claim correctly.
Rollout 1's read_skill('visual-verification') step correctly recognized in principle that item usage claims need clip_qa rather than text search, even though the chosen windows were wrong.
transferable_lessons: For 'which magic treasure was used in fight X' questions, do not stop at the first text hit for the treasure's name -- that is very likely the acquisition/inventory scene, not a combat-usage scene; instead locate the boss-defeat/boss-name text (which is far more literal and reliable in this DB) and only then clip_qa the HUD within that exact window.

When a video contains multiple similarly-typed encounters (multiple 'vanguard', 'chariot', or 'golem' bosses), verify boss identity via a literal victory/defeat banner or map-context text before trusting a semantic_search hit, since near-duplicate boss types are a major source of wrong-window errors here.

Always run clip_qa on the exact clue-adjacent time window before answering multi-part 'true/false per claim' questions that hinge on transient HUD state (equipped treasure icon); five separate mini-verifications are needed here, not one aggregate guess.

Cross-check candidate windows against total_intervals/clue-adjacent boss-defeat text for every sub-claim individually before submitting, rather than reusing one plausible-looking window (e.g. one 'chariot' fight) for the whole question.
open_questions: Whether the true chariot 'used embroidered needle' instant sits closer to 63930-64080 (rollout 3's window) or squarely inside 65229-65270 (the given clue interval) -- the two are close but not identical, and it is unclear if there are two separate needle-use moments or one continuous fight spanning both.

Whether the reference answer's boss names (Sui Commander, Sui Vanguard, Great Shigandang) are official localized names that map 1:1 to the DB's Chinese captions (赤焰麒麟, unnamed molten golem, 慈悲/blue-nodule boss) or whether some mapping is itself uncertain, which would affect how confidently any agent could resolve this question from captions alone without deep game-specific knowledge.
